what_this_is: The character reference set required by CLAUDE.md "The character directive". Each slot names what a builder must LOOK AT, which RI-VIS08/RI-VIS10 property it targets, and which of our own captures is its counterpart. Regenerate rather than hand-edit; the markdown index beside it cites these numbers.
standing_prohibitions: modern/character_fullbody/ is pixel_metrics_valid:false on every record — posed menu renders on a plain backdrop. Never quote an RI-VIS03 band from them and never use them for a framing, sky or composition statistic (n=0 there, by construction).
context/ESO-* remains barred as an ART-DIRECTION target by RI-VIS09 §2 and RI-VIS05. It is admitted here for CHARACTER CONSTRUCTION QUALITY only — see RI-VIS10 §A2.
GIF/video pixels are never used for texture, colour, AA or sharpness (RI-VIS09 §5a).
